regional_metrics.evaluation_scope: 49 all-observed development reconstruction views; no independent test or edited GT
regional_metrics.RGB_metric_source: Copied existing hybrid_raw JSON: clamped RGB, float64 error from stored FP32; pixels not recomputed in this audit
regional_metrics.alpha_metric_source: Copied existing raw unmasked alpha metrics, no body clipping
regional_metrics.aggregation: Arithmetic means of available finite per-frame values; empty regions remain missing, never filled with zero or dropped from the 49-row artifact

10000.aggregation: Arithmetic mean of per-frame PSNR, later macro-average scenes equally.
10000.perfect_error_policy: Zero-error frames have infinite mathematical PSNR; saved as null and counted separately, excluded from finite mean.
10000.mask_protocol: Explicit binary actor masks, union optional separately predicted shadows; nearest-neighbor resize.
10000.interpretation: PSNR* uses composite RGB on dynamic region. PSNR-S uses composite RGB on static region. PSNR-SR uses static-branch RGB on the same static region after deleting all dynamic Gaussians.
limitations: Paper masked-PSNR normalization is unspecified; both ROI and full-image zero-padded conventions are reported.
No deletion-hole quality is measured: historical unobstructed GT is required for Table V.
Inferred/prepared masks are not independent manually annotated ground truth.

NPS.boundary: Static-feature/static-RGB ratios are invalid where static-RGB is disconnected; recorded zero is not a gradient balance measurement. No complete Gaussian parameter-gradient comparison is certified.

addition_guard.checkpoint: legacy 18-field capture tuple; optional optimizer.sgcm_lineage_v1 payload
addition_guard.clone_limit: one SGCM clone per initial source lineage; all descendants inherit spent state
addition_guard.projection: Camera row-vector world_view/full_proj; center NDC x,y in [-1,1]
addition_guard.semantics: training-view support proxy; no occlusion or exact per-Gaussian contribution
addition_guard.split_children: both proposed children need support in at least one training view

SGCM.counter_total_semantics: Totals sum recorded per-call counters; an absent optional same-step duplicate field adds no observed count and is listed as missing, not independently certified zero.
SGCM.scope: Counts sum per-call observations, not unique points. Center-frustum/temporal-alpha support is a proxy; occlusion and exact per-Gaussian contribution are unmeasured. Logged counts do not independently prove every historical lineage identity.
